source_text: In the United States, Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. asserted in October 2025 a potential link between infant circumcision—often involving post-procedure acetaminophen (Tylenol) use—and increased autism risk, citing limited studies but lacking causal evidence. [150]
